versions.changelog: Adapt OpenClaw 2026.10.3 chat workbench, virtual scrolling, composer and portraits; repair Dreaming diary grids, tabs and responsive layouts; remove the diary tab underline; compact delivered CSS and reject entries above 256 KiB before writing; scope entry backups by Control UI build.

Fix OpenClaw 2026.8.1 Control UI regressions by making model and thinking-level selectors share the new-session composer width without overlap, and keeping expanded activity tool rows at their natural height so calls remain visible and scroll normally.

Adapt OpenClaw 2026.8.1 conversation/composer layout, fix header, transcript, progress/input, and model/effort stacking; retire unrendered Tool and Help/history portrait slots and assets while retaining five active chat/Dream visuals; and place label-free assistant/user portraits immediately beside the composer with exact 24px gaps and bottom alignment.
Adapt the OpenClaw 2026.7.1 composer shell wrapper so the complete chat input console stays anchored and visible at the bottom of the chat workspace.
Adapt OpenClaw 2026.6.9 nested chat-workbench composer and fix the right-side composer controls so usage, chat settings, and send stay visible in one row.

Stabilize the OpenClaw 2026.6.5 chat theme runtime by keeping quota badge, session fallback, and message timeline rewrites disabled by default, restoring HUD/avatar/header sync, deduplicating attribute-bearing theme injection blocks, and moving the bottom model picker back to the left tool group.

Consolidate the OpenClaw 2026.6.1 chat adapter, restore direct wallpaper visibility, hide the workspace files rail, make chat and tool bubbles transparent, dynamically reserve composer/footer space, and narrow the right Markdown drawer.
Republish the complete text-encoded default asset bundle so ClawHub installs can restore the bundled portraits and backgrounds instead of shipping only the installer fallback code.
Refresh the bundled cyberpunk theme assets and installer package for the current OpenClaw workspace theme.

Fix the WebChat session picker stacking chain by removing the old clipping overflow and lifting the chat header plus session-picker layers above the transcript, so the dropdown no longer gets covered by chat messages.

Fix live control-ui dist auto-detection for re-apply on non-Homebrew OpenClaw installs, and fully remove the remaining dream-stage glass overlay/tint so the dream page finally matches the 1.0.13 design intent.
Remove the dream page frosted-glass overlay and extra stage tint so the dream content sits directly on the background art instead of a separate glass panel.

Fix the WebUI chat timeline merge so same-timestamp events stay in the intended order: user -> assistant tool -> toolResult -> assistant text, instead of letting the final reply jump ahead of the tool stream.
Render tool and helper portraits through real img layers instead of CSS-only background images, fixing the severe blur/compression artifact on those two avatar paths.
Fix the chat nameplates so helper is pinned to 消息助手 helper, while the main assistant nameplate is derived from IDENTITY.md or SOUL.md instead of hard-coded 菠萝包 labels.
Tune the expanded right drawer spacing so the top control gap and bottom composer gap are visually balanced.
Add a configurable help/history portrait slot via --help-avatar and helpAvatar, and sync the bundled Control UI theme assets.
Show Codex chat quota as separate 5h and weekly remaining windows, and keep the cyberpunk theme asset bundle in sync with the workspace Control UI overlay.
Adapt OpenClaw 2026.5 composer toolbar so left-side icon buttons keep their text labels and spacing while preserving the themed footer controls.
Adapt OpenClaw 2026.5 footer status layer so context usage, compaction, and run-status indicators stay visible above the floating composer.
Adapt OpenClaw 2026.5 composer buttons, restore right-side button labels, fix compressed SVG icons, tune theme button colors, and rebalance chat input spacing.
Simplified SKILL.md to focus on purpose, configuration, usage, and installed result.
Added PNG store preview and JSON-based theme config import.
Added branded skill artwork and clearer customization quickstart.
Initial release: one-click cyberpunk chat/dream theme with configurable portraits and backgrounds.
